# Apprentice

> An Agent-Native app for issue triage. It records a maintainer's UI clicks as typed demonstrations, turns repeated patterns into editable playbooks, backtests them on the user's own history, turns every correction into a regression test, and earns autonomy on a trust ladder (Watch, Suggest, Draft, Act, Auto) built on the framework's `needsApproval` gate. Built for the Builder.io Agent-Native Hackathon, November 2026.

Live app: https://apprentice-agent.onrender.com (demo login judge@apprentice-demo.dev / apprentice-demo-2026)
Website: https://apprentice-agent.pages.dev
Demo film (3 min, public, agent-readable transcript): https://clips.agent-native.com/share/77mChMteEQ6M
Stack: Agent-Native 0.226 (React Router + Nitro), TypeScript strict, Drizzle, Postgres (Neon) / PGlite, Vitest.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what it does, demo, rubric-to-evidence table, how to run
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): system diagram, learning loop, trust ladder, data model, engine and services map
- [docs/AGENT-NATIVE-EVIDENCE.md](docs/AGENT-NATIVE-EVIDENCE.md): every Agent-Native claim with file and line
- [BUILT-DURING-HACKATHON.md](BUILT-DURING-HACKATHON.md): pre-existing template vs. new work
- [PROGRESS.md](PROGRESS.md): verification log (tests, browser click-through, deployment)

## Key code

- [actions/](actions/): 62 `defineAction` files; the UI, agent, MCP, CLI and scheduler all call these
- [server/apprentice/action-helpers.ts](server/apprentice/action-helpers.ts): `domainAction` wires `needsApproval`, audit target and the single write path
- [server/apprentice/services/issues.ts](server/apprentice/services/issues.ts): `mutateIssue`, the only issue write path; decides demonstration vs. playbook execution
- [server/apprentice/services/record-step.ts](server/apprentice/services/record-step.ts): records demonstrations with app-state snapshots
- [server/apprentice/services/approval.ts](server/apprentice/services/approval.ts): the trust-ladder predicate
- [server/apprentice/services/executor.ts](server/apprentice/services/executor.ts): runs, decisions, review, drift, undo, provenance
- [server/apprentice/engine/](server/apprentice/engine/): pure TypeScript learning engine (features, patterns, trigger inference, backtest, tests, trust, prediction, SKILL.md)
- [server/db/schema.ts](server/db/schema.ts): 15 tables
- [app/routes/](app/routes/): UI screens; [app/components/apprentice/](app/components/apprentice/): domain components
- [server/plugins/agent-chat.ts](server/plugins/agent-chat.ts): agent system prompt and tool registry
- [.agents/skills/](.agents/skills/): triage-domain, apprentice-teacher, playbook-runner, shadow-reviewer
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for the in-app agent at runtime (not a repo guide)

## Verify

- `pnpm install && pnpm typecheck` (clean)
- `pnpm test` (55 tests, including the full-loop integration test in server/apprentice/__tests__/flow.test.ts)
- `pnpm agent-native:doctor` (framework guards)
- `pnpm dev`, then Load demo data at http://localhost:8080
